basic_info.description: Charming Condo in Potrero Hill District with Unique Features! Welcome to this beautifully remodeled 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo nestled in the  highly sought-after Potrero Hill area of SF, complete with breathtaking views of the city. This quirky and delightful space combines modern amenities with unique architectural charm, perfect for anyone looking to enjoy vibrant city living in a peaceful, sun-drenched neighborhood. Step inside to discover elegant porcelain tile floors, setting the tone for stylish and low-maintenance living. The remodeled kitchen features contemporary appliances, sleek finishes, and generous storage. The updated bathroom offers a spa-like retreat, complete with a deep soaking tub, ideal for unwinding after a long day. Outside, enjoy the tranquility of an open hillside adorned with lush trees and shrubs, offering a rare natural escape in the heart of the city. A charming stairwell adjacent to the property connects Carolina and 20th Streets, inviting you to explore the neighborhood's beloved cafes, restaurants, and scenic views. Potrero Hill is known for its warm microclimate, panoramic vistas, and easy access to downtown, Mission Bay, and the lively SOMA district. Muni and Caltrain are both within a 10-minute walking distance. See:666ACarolinastreet.com
